verses.original: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις ἐν Καισαρείᾳ ὀνόματι Κορνήλιος ἑκατοντάρχης ἐκ σπείρης τῆς καλουμένης Ἰταλικῆς
verses.transliteration: Anēr de tis en Kaisareia onomati Kornēlios hekatontarchēs ek speirēs tēs kaloumenēs Italikēs
verses.literal: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment
verses.literalPt: Um homem em Cesareia, por nome Cornélio, centurião de uma coorte chamada Italiana,

verses.original: εὐσεβὴς καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν Θεὸν σὺν παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ποιῶν ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς τῷ λαῷ καὶ δεόμενος τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ παντός
verses.transliteration: eusebēs kai phoboumenos ton Theon syn panti tō oikō autou poiōn eleēmosynas pollas tō laō kai deomenos tou Theou dia pantos
verses.literal: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing . . . . . . He gave generously . . . . . . to the people and prayed to God regularly . . .
verses.literalPt: piedoso e temente a Deus com toda a sua casa, e que fazia muitas esmolas ao povo e de contínuo orava a Deus,

verses.original: εἶδεν ἐν ὁράματι φανερῶς ὡσεὶ περὶ ὥραν ἐνάτην τῆς ἡμέρας ἄγγελον τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθόντα πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἰπόντα αὐτῷ Κορνήλιε
verses.transliteration: eiden en horamati phanerōs hōsei peri hōran enatēn tēs hēmeras angelon tou Theou eiselthonta pros auton kai eiponta autō Kornēlie
verses.literal: One day at about . . . the ninth hour he had a clear vision . . . . . . . . . of an angel of God who came to him and said Cornelius
verses.literalPt: viu em visão claramente, cerca da hora nona do dia, um anjo chegando e dizendo:

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀτενίσας αὐτῷ καὶ ἔμφοβος γενόμενος εἶπεν Τί ἐστιν Κύριε Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Αἱ προσευχαί σου καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἀνέβησαν εἰς μνημόσυνον ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de atenisas autō kai emphobos genomenos eipen Ti estin Kyrie Eipen de autō Hai proseuchai sou kai hai eleēmosynai sou anebēsan eis mnēmosynon emprosthen tou Theou
verses.literal: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked What is it Lord The angel answered Your prayers and - gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God
verses.literalPt: Cornélio! Este, fitando nele os olhos e cheio de temor, perguntou: Que é, Senhor? O anjo acrescentou: As tuas orações e as tuas esmolas têm subido para lembrança diante de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν πέμψον ἄνδρας εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνά τινα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος
verses.transliteration: kai nyn pempson andras eis Ioppēn kai metapempsai Simōna tina hos epikaleitai Petros
verses.literal: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter
verses.literalPt: Agora, envia homens a Jope e manda chamar um certo Simão que tem por sobrenome Pedro;

verses.original: οὗτος ξενίζεται παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ ᾧ ἐστιν οἰκία παρὰ θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: houtos xenizetai para tini Simōni byrsei hō estin oikia para thalassan
verses.literal: He is staying with Simon the tanner whose house is by the sea
verses.literalPt: este se acha hospedado em casa de um curtidor chamado Simão, a qual fica junto ao mar.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν αὐτῷ φωνήσας δύο τῶν οἰκετῶν καὶ στρατιώτην εὐσεβῆ τῶν προσκαρτερούντων αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Hōs de apēlthen ho angelos ho lalōn autō phōnēsas dyo tōn oiketōn kai stratiōtēn eusebē tōn proskarterountōn autō
verses.literal: When the angel who spoke to him had gone Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants . . .
verses.literalPt: Logo que se retirou o anjo que lhe falava, chamou a dois dos seus domésticos e a um soldado piedoso dos que estavam ao seu serviço

verses.original: καὶ ἐξηγησάμενος ἅπαντα αὐτοῖς ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν Ἰόππην
verses.transliteration: kai exēgēsamenos hapanta autois apesteilen autous eis tēn Ioppēn
verses.literal: He explained . . . what had happened and sent them to Joppa
verses.literalPt: e, havendo-lhes contado tudo, enviou-os a Jope.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ὁδοιπορούντων ἐκείνων καὶ τῇ πόλει ἐγγιζόντων ἀνέβη Πέτρος ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα προσεύξασθαι περὶ ὥραν ἕκτην
verses.transliteration: Tē de epaurion hodoiporountōn ekeinōn kai tē polei engizontōn anebē Petros epi to dōma proseuxasthai peri hōran hektēn
verses.literal: The next day at about the sixth hour as the men were approaching the city on their journey Peter went up on the roof to pray
verses.literalPt: Ao outro dia, seguindo eles o seu caminho e estando já perto da cidade, subiu Pedro ao eirado para orar, cerca da hora sexta.

verses.original: ἐγένετο δὲ πρόσπεινος καὶ ἤθελεν γεύσασθαι παρασκευαζόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐγένετο ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἔκστασις
verses.transliteration: egeneto de prospeinos kai ēthelen geusasthai paraskeuazontōn de autōn egeneto ep’ auton ekstasis
verses.literal: He became hungry and wanted something to eat but while the meal was being prepared he fell into a trance
verses.literalPt: Teve ele fome e quis comer; mas, enquanto lhe aprontavam a comida, veio-lhe um êxtase;

verses.original: καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγμένον καὶ καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιέμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: kai theōrei ton ouranon aneōgmenon kai katabainon skeuos ti hōs othonēn megalēn tessarsin archais kathiemenon epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: He saw heaven open and something . . . like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners
verses.literalPt: viu o céu aberto e descer um objeto como se fora uma grande toalha, o qual era baixado à terra pelas quatro pontas,

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ὑπῆρχεν πάντα τὰ τετράποδα καὶ ἑρπετὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hō hypērchen panta ta tetrapoda kai herpeta tēs gēs kai peteina tou ouranou
verses.literal: It contained . . . . . . all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth as well as birds of the air
verses.literalPt: e nele havia de todos os quadrúpedes e répteis da terra e aves do céu.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀναστάς Πέτρε θῦσον καὶ φάγε
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto phōnē pros auton Anastas Petre thyson kai phage
verses.literal: Then a voice said to him Get up Peter kill and eat
verses.literalPt: Uma voz disse-lhe: Levanta-te, Pedro! Mata e come.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἶπεν Μηδαμῶς Κύριε ὅτι οὐδέποτε ἔφαγον πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ἀκάθαρτον
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros eipen Mēdamōs Kyrie hoti oudepote ephagon pan koinon kai akatharton
verses.literal: No Lord - Peter answered I have never eaten anything impure or unclean
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro replicou: De nenhum modo, Senhor, porque jamais comi coisa alguma impura e imunda.

verses.original: Καὶ φωνὴ πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου πρὸς αὐτόν Ἃ ὁ Θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου
verses.transliteration: Kai phōnē palin ek deuterou pros auton Ha ho Theos ekatharisen sy mē koinou
verses.literal: The voice spoke to him a second time Do not call anything impure that God has made clean
verses.literalPt: Segunda vez, a voz lhe falou: Ao que Deus purificou, não faças tu impuro.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνελήμφθη τὸ σκεῦος εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: Touto de egeneto epi tris kai euthys anelēmphthē to skeuos eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: This happened three times and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu isso por três vezes, e logo o objeto foi recolhido ao céu.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ διηπόρει ὁ Πέτρος τί ἂν εἴη τὸ ὅραμα ὃ εἶδεν ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κορνηλίου διερωτήσαντες τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ Σίμωνος ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὸν πυλῶνα
verses.transliteration: Hōs de en heautō diēporei ho Petros ti an eiē to horama ho eiden idou hoi andres hoi apestalmenoi hypo tou Kornēliou dierōtēsantes tēn oikian tou Simōnos epestēsan epi ton pylōna
verses.literal: While Peter was puzzling over . . . . . . the meaning . . . of the vision . . . . . . the men sent by Cornelius found - Simon’s house and approached . . . the gate
verses.literalPt: Enquanto Pedro estava consigo perplexo sobre o que seria a visão que tinha tido, eis que os homens que haviam sido enviados por Cornélio, tendo perguntado pela casa de Simão, pararam à porta

verses.original: καὶ φωνήσαντες ἐπυνθάνοντο εἰ Σίμων ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος Πέτρος ἐνθάδε ξενίζεται
verses.transliteration: kai phōnēsantes epynthanonto ei Simōn ho epikaloumenos Petros enthade xenizetai
verses.literal: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there
verses.literalPt: e, chamando, indagavam se estava ali hospedado Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Pedro.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ Πέτρου διενθυμουμένου περὶ τοῦ ὁράματος εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ Πνεῦμα Ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες τρεῖς ζητοῦντές σε
verses.transliteration: Tou de Petrou dienthymoumenou peri tou horamatos eipen autō to Pneuma Idou andres treis zētountes se
verses.literal: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision the Spirit said to him Behold three men are looking for you
verses.literalPt: Enquanto Pedro estava meditando sobre a visão, disse-lhe o Espírito: Eis que dois homens te procuram;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀναστὰς κατάβηθι καὶ πορεύου σὺν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρινόμενος ὅτι ἐγὼ ἀπέσταλκα αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: alla anastas katabēthi kai poreuou syn autois mēden diakrinomenos hoti egō apestalka autous
verses.literal: So get up Go downstairs and accompany . . . them without hesitation because I have sent them
verses.literalPt: levanta-te, pois, desce e vai com eles, nada duvidando; porque eu os enviei.

verses.original: Καταβὰς δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι ὃν ζητεῖτε τίς ἡ αἰτία δι’ ἣν πάρεστε
verses.transliteration: Katabas de Petros pros tous andras eipen Idou egō eimi hon zēteite tis hē aitia di’ hēn pareste
verses.literal: So Peter went down to the men and said Here am I the one you are looking for Why . . . . . . . . . . . . have you come
verses.literalPt: Descendo Pedro ao encontro desses homens, disse: Sou eu a quem procurais; qual é a causa por que viestes?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Κορνήλιος ἑκατοντάρχης ἀνὴρ δίκαιος καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν Θεὸν μαρτυρούμενός τε ὑπὸ ὅλου τοῦ ἔθνους τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐχρηματίσθη ὑπὸ ἀγγέλου ἁγίου μεταπέμψασθαί σε εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ῥήματα παρὰ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan Kornēlios hekatontarchēs anēr dikaios kai phoboumenos ton Theon martyroumenos te hypo holou tou ethnous tōn Ioudaiōn echrēmatisthē hypo angelou hagiou metapempsasthai se eis ton oikon autou kai akousai rhēmata para sou
verses.literal: Cornelius the centurion has sent us - they said He is a righteous and God-fearing . . . man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation A holy angel instructed him . . . to request your presence . . . in his home so he could hear a message from you
verses.literalPt: Eles responderam: O centurião Cornélio, homem justo e temente a Deus, tendo bom testemunho de toda a nação judaica, recebeu um aviso de Deus, por meio de um santo anjo, que te mandasse chamar para sua casa e ouvisse as tuas palavras.

verses.original: Εἰσκαλεσάμενος οὖν αὐτοὺς ἐξένισεν Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς καί τινες τῶν ἀδελφῶν τῶν ἀπὸ Ἰόππης συνῆλθον αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Eiskalesamenos oun autous exenisen Tē de epaurion anastas exēlthen syn autois kai tines tōn adelphōn tōn apo Ioppēs synēlthon autō
verses.literal: So Peter invited them in . . . as his guests And the next day he got ready and went with them accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa
verses.literalPt: Pedro, pois, convidando-os a entrar, hospedou-os. No dia seguinte, levantou-se e partiu com eles, e alguns irmãos de Jope acompanharam-no.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν Καισάρειαν ὁ δὲ Κορνήλιος ἦν προσδοκῶν αὐτοὺς συνκαλεσάμενος τοὺς συγγενεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἀναγκαίους φίλους
verses.transliteration: Tē de epaurion eisēlthen eis tēn Kaisareian ho de Kornēlios ēn prosdokōn autous synkalesamenos tous syngeneis autou kai tous anankaious philous
verses.literal: The following day he arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends
verses.literalPt: No outro dia, entrou em Cesareia. Cornélio estava esperando por eles, tendo reunido seus parentes e amigos íntimos.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν τὸν Πέτρον συναντήσας αὐτῷ ὁ Κορνήλιος πεσὼν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας προσεκύνησεν
verses.transliteration: Hōs de egeneto tou eiselthein ton Petron synantēsas autō ho Kornēlios pesōn epi tous podas prosekynēsen
verses.literal: As Peter was about to enter Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him
verses.literalPt: Quando Pedro ia entrar, veio Cornélio recebê-lo e, prostrando-se-lhe aos pés, adorou-o.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν λέγων Ἀνάστηθι καὶ ἐγὼ αὐτὸς ἄνθρωπός εἰμι
verses.transliteration: ho de Petros ēgeiren auton legōn Anastēthi kai egō autos anthrōpos eimi
verses.literal: But Peter helped him up . . . Stand up he said I am only a man myself
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro ergueu-o, dizendo: Levanta-te, que eu também sou homem.

verses.original: Καὶ συνομιλῶν αὐτῷ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ εὑρίσκει συνεληλυθότας πολλούς
verses.transliteration: Kai synomilōn autō eisēlthen kai heuriskei synelēlythotas pollous
verses.literal: As Peter talked with him he went inside and found many people gathered together
verses.literalPt: Falando com ele, entrou, e achou muitos reunidos,

verses.original: ἔφη τε πρὸς αὐτούς Ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὡς ἀθέμιτόν ἐστιν ἀνδρὶ Ἰουδαίῳ κολλᾶσθαι ἢ προσέρχεσθαι ἀλλοφύλῳ κἀμοὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἔδειξεν μηδένα κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον λέγειν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: ephē te pros autous Hymeis epistasthe hōs athemiton estin andri Ioudaiō kollasthai ē proserchesthai allophylō kamoi ho Theos edeixen mēdena koinon ē akatharton legein anthrōpon
verses.literal: He said to them You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean
verses.literalPt: e disse-lhes: Vós bem sabeis que é proibido a um judeu ajuntar-se ou chegar-se a um de outra nação; todavia, Deus mostrou-me que a ninguém chamasse impuro ou imundo;

verses.original: διὸ καὶ ἀναντιρρήτως ἦλθον μεταπεμφθείς πυνθάνομαι οὖν Τίνι λόγῳ μετεπέμψασθέ με
verses.transliteration: dio kai anantirrētōs ēlthon metapemphtheis pynthanomai oun Tini logō metepempsasthe me
verses.literal: So when I was invited I came without objection I ask then why . . . have you sent for me
verses.literalPt: por isso, sem objeção, vim logo que fui chamado. Pergunto, pois, por que razão me mandaste chamar?

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Κορνήλιος ἔφη Ἀπὸ τετάρτης ἡμέρας μέχρι ταύτης τῆς ὥρας ἤμην τὴν ἐνάτην προσευχόμενος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἔστη ἐνώπιόν μου ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Kornēlios ephē Apo tetartēs hēmeras mechri tautēs tēs hōras ēmēn tēn enatēn proseuchomenos en tō oikō mou kai idou anēr estē enōpion mou en esthēti lampra
verses.literal: Cornelius answered Four days ago I was in my house praying at this the ninth hour Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Cornélio: Faz agora quatro dias que eu estava orando à hora nona em minha casa, e eis que se apresentou diante de mim um varão de vestidura resplandecente

verses.original: καὶ φησίν Κορνήλιε εἰσηκούσθη σου ἡ προσευχὴ καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἐμνήσθησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai phēsin Kornēlie eisēkousthē sou hē proseuchē kai hai eleēmosynai sou emnēsthēsan enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: and said Cornelius your prayer has been heard and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God
verses.literalPt: e disse: Cornélio, a tua oração foi ouvida, e as tuas esmolas foram lembradas na presença de Deus.

verses.original: πέμψον οὖν εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετακάλεσαι Σίμωνα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος οὗτος ξενίζεται ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος βυρσέως παρὰ θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: pempson oun eis Ioppēn kai metakalesai Simōna hos epikaleitai Petros houtos xenizetai en oikia Simōnos byrseōs para thalassan
verses.literal: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner by the sea
verses.literalPt: Envia, pois, a Jope e chama a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro; este se acha hospedado na casa de Simão, curtidor, à beira-mar.

verses.original: Ἐξαυτῆς οὖν ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ σύ τε καλῶς ἐποίησας παραγενόμενος νῦν οὖν πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ πάρεσμεν ἀκοῦσαι πάντα τὰ προστεταγμένα σοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Exautēs oun epempsa pros se sy te kalōs epoiēsas paragenomenos nyn oun pantes hēmeis enōpion tou Theou paresmen akousai panta ta prostetagmena soi hypo tou Kyriou
verses.literal: So I sent for you immediately and you were kind enough to come Now then we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed . . . you to tell us
verses.literalPt: Portanto, mandei logo chamar-te, e tu fizeste bem em vir. Agora, pois, todos nós estamos aqui diante de Deus, para ouvir tudo o que te foi ordenado pelo Senhor.

verses.original: Ἀνοίξας δὲ Πέτρος τὸ στόμα εἶπεν Ἐπ’ ἀληθείας καταλαμβάνομαι ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολήμπτης ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Anoixas de Petros to stoma eipen Ep’ alētheias katalambanomai hoti ouk estin prosōpolēmptēs ho Theos
verses.literal: Then Peter began to speak . . . . . . . . . I now truly understand . . . . . . that God does not show favoritism
verses.literalPt: Pedro começou a falar e disse: Na verdade, reconheço que Deus não se deixa levar de respeitos humanos,

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει ὁ φοβούμενος αὐτὸν καὶ ἐργαζόμενος δικαιοσύνην δεκτὸς αὐτῷ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: all’ en panti ethnei ho phoboumenos auton kai ergazomenos dikaiosynēn dektos autō estin
verses.literal: but welcomes . . . those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right
verses.literalPt: mas que em toda a nação aquele que o teme e faz o que é justo, este lhe é aceito;

verses.original: τὸν λόγον ὃν ἀπέστειλεν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ εὐαγγελιζόμενος εἰρήνην διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ οὗτός ἐστιν πάντων Κύριος
verses.transliteration: ton logon hon apesteilen tois huiois Israēl euangelizomenos eirēnēn dia Iēsou Christou houtos estin pantōn Kyrios
verses.literal: He has sent this message to the people of Israel proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ who is Lord of all
verses.literalPt: esta é a mensagem que Deus enviou aos filhos de Israel, evangelizando-lhes a paz por meio de Jesus Cristo — este é o Senhor de todos.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς οἴδατε τὸ γενόμενον ῥῆμα καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας μετὰ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐκήρυξεν Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: Hymeis oidate to genomenon rhēma kath’ holēs tēs Ioudaias arxamenos apo tēs Galilaias meta to baptisma ho ekēryxen Iōannēs
verses.literal: You yourselves know what has happened . . . throughout . . . Judea beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed
verses.literalPt: Vós sabeis o que sucedeu por toda a Judeia, começando desde a Galileia, depois do batismo que pregou João,

verses.original: Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέθ ὡς ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν ὁ Θεὸς Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ δυνάμει ὃς διῆλθεν εὐεργετῶν καὶ ἰώμενος πάντας τοὺς καταδυναστευομένους ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Iēsoun ton apo Nazareth hōs echrisen auton ho Theos Pneumati Hagiō kai dynamei hos diēlthen euergetōn kai iōmenos pantas tous katadynasteuomenous hypo tou diabolou hoti ho Theos ēn met’ autou
verses.literal: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil because God was with Him
verses.literalPt: como Deus ungiu a Jesus de Nazaré com o Espírito Santo e poder, o qual andou por toda parte, fazendo o bem e sarando a todos os oprimidos do Diabo,

verses.original: Καὶ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρες πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν ἔν τε τῇ χώρᾳ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ὃν καὶ ἀνεῖλαν κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου
verses.transliteration: Kai hēmeis martyres pantōn hōn epoiēsen en te tē chōra tōn Ioudaiōn kai en Ierousalēm hon kai aneilan kremasantes epi xylou
verses.literal: We are witnesses of all that He did both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree
verses.literalPt: porque Deus era com ele; e nós somos testemunhas de tudo o que se fez na terra dos judeus e em Jerusalém; ao qual também tiraram a vida, pendurando-o em um madeiro.

verses.original: τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν ἐμφανῆ γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: touton ho Theos ēgeiren en tē tritē hēmera kai edōken auton emphanē genesthai
verses.literal: God raised Him up . . . on the third day and caused Him to be seen
verses.literalPt: A este ressuscitou Deus ao terceiro dia e concedeu que fosse ele manifesto,

verses.original: οὐ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἀλλὰ μάρτυσιν τοῖς προκεχειροτονημένοις ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῖν οἵτινες συνεφάγομεν καὶ συνεπίομεν αὐτῷ μετὰ τὸ ἀναστῆναι αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ou panti tō laō alla martysin tois prokecheirotonēmenois hypo tou Theou hēmin hoitines synephagomen kai synepiomen autō meta to anastēnai auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: not by all the people but by the witnesses - God had chosen beforehand by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead
verses.literalPt: não a todo o povo, mas às testemunhas que Deus tinha antes escolhido, a nós que comemos e bebemos com ele, depois que ressurgiu dentre os mortos;

verses.original: καὶ παρήγγειλεν ἡμῖν κηρύξαι τῷ λαῷ καὶ διαμαρτύρασθαι ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ὡρισμένος ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Κριτὴς ζώντων καὶ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: kai parēngeilen hēmin kēryxai tō laō kai diamartyrasthai hoti houtos estin ho hōrismenos hypo tou Theou Kritēs zōntōn kai nekrōn
verses.literal: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead
verses.literalPt: e nos mandou pregar ao povo e testificar que ele é o que por Deus tem sido constituído juiz de vivos e mortos.

verses.original: τούτῳ πάντες οἱ προφῆται μαρτυροῦσιν ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν λαβεῖν διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ πάντα τὸν πιστεύοντα εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: toutō pantes hoi prophētai martyrousin aphesin hamartiōn labein dia tou onomatos autou panta ton pisteuonta eis auton
verses.literal: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name
verses.literalPt: A ele todos os profetas dão testemunho de que, por meio de seu nome, todo o que nele crê recebe remissão de pecados.

verses.original: Ἔτι λαλοῦντος τοῦ Πέτρου τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐπέπεσεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας τὸν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Eti lalountos tou Petrou ta rhēmata tauta epepesen to Pneuma to Hagion epi pantas tous akouontas ton logon
verses.literal: While Peter was still speaking these words the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message
verses.literalPt: Enquanto Pedro ainda falava essas coisas, desceu o Espírito Santo sobre todos os que ouviam a palavra.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς πιστοὶ ὅσοι συνῆλθαν τῷ Πέτρῳ ὅτι καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἡ δωρεὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐκκέχυται
verses.transliteration: kai exestēsan hoi ek peritomēs pistoi hosoi synēlthan tō Petrō hoti kai epi ta ethnē hē dōrea tou Hagiou Pneumatos ekkechytai
verses.literal: All . . . the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles
verses.literalPt: Admiraram-se todos os crentes que eram da circuncisão, quantos vieram com Pedro, porque também sobre os gentios foi derramado o dom do Espírito Santo,

verses.original: ἤκουον γὰρ αὐτῶν λαλούντων γλώσσαις καὶ μεγαλυνόντων τὸν Θεόν Τότε ἀπεκρίθη Πέτρος
verses.transliteration: ēkouon gar autōn lalountōn glōssais kai megalynontōn ton Theon Tote apekrithē Petros
verses.literal: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God Then Peter said
verses.literalPt: pois os ouviam falar outras línguas e engrandecer a Deus. Então, perguntou Pedro:

verses.original: Μήτι τὸ ὕδωρ δύναται κωλῦσαί τις τοῦ μὴ βαπτισθῆναι τούτους οἵτινες τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἔλαβον ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: Mēti to hydōr dynatai kōlysai tis tou mē baptisthēnai toutous hoitines to Pneuma to Hagion elabon hōs kai hēmeis
verses.literal: Can . . . anyone withhold the water to baptize these people They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have
verses.literalPt: Porventura, pode alguém negar a água, para que não sejam batizados estes que receberam o Espírito Santo como nós?

verses.original: προσέταξεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ βαπτισθῆναι τότε ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν ἐπιμεῖναι ἡμέρας τινάς
verses.transliteration: prosetaxen de autous en tō onomati Iēsou Christou baptisthēnai tote ērōtēsan auton epimeinai hēmeras tinas
verses.literal: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ Then they asked him to stay for a few days
verses.literalPt: E ordenou que fossem batizados em nome de Jesus Cristo. Então, lhe rogaram que se demorasse ali alguns dias.
